# Triage labels

The skills use five triage roles.
This table maps each role to the label string used by this repo's tracker.

| Role in astack | Label in our tracker | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `needs-triage` | `needs-triage` | A maintainer must evaluate the issue |
| `needs-info` | `needs-info` | The reporter must supply more information |
| `ready-for-agent` | `ready-for-agent` | The issue has a complete specification for an AFK agent |
| `ready-for-human` | `ready-for-human` | The issue requires a human implementer |
| `wontfix` | `wontfix` | The issue will receive no implementation |

When a skill names a role, use the corresponding tracker label from this table.
For example, an AFK-ready label means the row for `ready-for-agent`.
Edit "Label in our tracker" to match the repo's vocabulary.
